priority.Idle clips: Core (so default walk and run still show on the legs)
priority.Train clips: Action (TrainStrike, TrainPush, TrainLift, TrainMeditate; all looped)
priority.HeroWalkIn: Movement (looped; the game moves the root at 2.1063 studs/s)
priority.CarryHold: Action, UPPER BODY ONLY (legs and LowerTorso unkeyed, so the default walk keeps the legs)

clips.name: Throw
clips.reference: full-power overhand throw (pitching / javelin phases): pivot step side-on, lead knee up, long stride, hips open before the shoulders, arm cocked and whipped over the top, release high in front of the head, follow-through across the body, back leg swings through, recover to a stand; 1.5 s, Release marker at 0.7667 s (frame 23)
clips._intent: the core verb; must read as maximum effort from the chase camera behind the player

clips.name: TrainStrike
clips.reference: boxing heavy-bag combo jab-cross-left hook-right uppercut from an orthodox guard, 2.0 s loop, Hit markers at 0.2/0.6/1.0/1.4 s; every fist lands ON the bag face 2.5 studs in front of the HumanoidRootPart
clips._intent: reps on dummy, sandbag and iron dummy; the player is snapped to a stand point so the target front face is at contact_distance

clips.name: TrainPush
clips.reference: pushing an immovable boulder from a long lunge, both palms flat on its face 2.45 studs in front of the HumanoidRootPart, sink then drive surge, 1.2 s loop, Hit marker at 0.5333 s
clips._intent: reps on the stone pillar; the player is snapped so the pillar face is at contact_distance

clips.name: TrainLift
clips.reference: alternating standing dumbbell hammer curls, a dumbbell welded in EACH hand (Part0 = RightHand/LeftHand, centred on the hand part, long axis on the hand part's Z), 2.0 s loop, Rep markers at 0.4667 and 1.4667 s
clips._intent: reps at a weights station; looped, Action priority

clips.name: TrainMeditate
clips.reference: seated lotus with a breathing pulse and a fist-clench on the beat, 1.0 s loop
clips._intent: reps at waterfall, gravity dojo and shrines

clips.name: Celebrate
clips.reference: fist pump jump, 1.2 s, lands back in idle
clips._intent: player reaction to a Rare or better catch

clips.name: IdleCool
clips.reference: arms crossed, weight on one leg, slow head turn, 3 s loop
clips._intent: arms-crossed stance

clips.name: IdleCheer
clips.reference: idol wave with a small bounce, 2 s loop
clips._intent: bouncy wave

clips.name: IdleBlade
clips.reference: one hand resting on the hilt at the hip, the other relaxed; swords are carried edge up at the waist, polearms head up; 3 s loop
clips._intent: hand on sword, weapon carried the way that class is carried

clips.name: IdleNinja
clips.reference: low ready stance, one hand in a two-finger sign at the chest, 3 s loop
clips._intent: low ready crouch with hand sign

clips.name: IdlePower
clips.reference: feet wide, fists clenched at the sides, shoulders rise and fall, 2 s loop
clips._intent: clenched-fist power stance used by aura characters

clips.name: IdleShy
clips.reference: hands behind the back, toe tap and sway, 3 s loop
clips._intent: hands behind back, small sway

clips.name: IdleFloat
clips.reference: legs relaxed off the ground, arms slightly out, slow vertical drift authored on the root, 4 s loop
clips._intent: hover with slow drift

clips.name: Eat
clips.reference: crouch, pick up, two bites, thumbs up, 1.6 s
clips._intent: the lured character eats the food: sells the fantasy of the title

clips.name: RevealLand
clips.reference: three-point hero landing rising into a pose, 1.0 s
clips._intent: hero landing pose at the reveal

clips.name: HeroWalkIn
clips.reference: weighty hero-entrance walk cycle, heel strike to toe-off, chest up, counter-turning shoulders, arms swinging with intent; 1.1333 s loop (34 frames), 2 steps, Step markers at 0.2667 (right foot) and 0.8333 (left foot); stride 2.3871 studs per cycle = 2.1063 studs/s, move the HumanoidRootPart at that speed for zero foot slide
clips._intent: the 3D hero walks in during the catch reveal

clips.name: HeroArrive
clips.reference: last step into a stomp and a fists-clenched power stance, 0.9 s, Plant marker at 0.4; start it at HeroWalkIn's RIGHT Step (TimePosition 0.2667) and move the root 0.64 studs forward over 0.6077 s with Quad Out; ends near IdlePower's first pose
clips._intent: the hero arrives and plants at the reveal spot

clips.name: CarryHold
clips.reference: caught hero (0.55 scale) held up overhead like a trophy, hands gripping its ankles from the sides, palms facing; 1.2 s loop, upper body only (pose_only: UpperTorso, Head, arms, hands); hand centres HRP-space (+-1.05, 2.36, -0.42), hero LowerTorso centre (0, 3.31, -0.42)
clips._intent: the player carries the caught hero to their base

clips.name: PlaceHero
clips.reference: squat and set the carried hero onto a 1-stud pedestal in front (pedestal top = ground + 1, its centre 1.85 studs ahead of the HRP), release, right fist pump to the sky and yank down; 1.2 s, Place marker at 0.5333
clips._intent: the player places the hero on a pedestal at the base

clips.name: RebirthEvolve
clips.reference: power-up: wide crouch with fists drawn in at the waist and a growing tremble (0-1.2 s), explode onto the balls of the feet with arms flung up in a V and head back (Burst marker at 1.3667), hold the V pose with a slow breath to 3.0 s
clips._intent: rebirth / evolve moment

clips.name: HeroStalk
clips.reference: slow menacing villain stride: heavy heel-to-toe steps, chest a little forward, shoulders rolling, head low, arms loose with a small swing, no bob; 1.6667 s loop (50 frames), 2 steps, Step markers at 0.2667 (right) and 1.1 (left); 2.5 studs per cycle = 1.5 studs/s, move the HumanoidRootPart at that speed
clips._intent: the silhouette stalks up the lane during the catch reveal (owner's review 3: slow, step by step, not hyper)

clips.name: HeroMenace
clips.reference: after the stalk: plants, the trailing foot takes one slow step, head comes up to the camera (Look 1.2), shoulders roll back, fists clench at the sides with a chest lift (Power 1.6667); 2.2 s, holds the last pose; start at HeroStalk's right Step and move the root 0.5 studs forward over 0.6667 s with Quad Out
clips._intent: the hero stops in front of the food and powers up before the name

clips.name: RebirthAwaken
clips.reference: villain level-up: on one knee, fist on the floor, head bowed (0-1.2), slow trembling rise (Rise 1.2), explodes up with head back and arms wide (Burst 3.5), power stance (Stance 4.4), slow breath to 6.0 s; starts kneeling, so fade it in under a cut
clips._intent: the rebirth cinematic (owner's review 3: longer, like a villain who levels up)

clips.name: HeroPickUp
clips.reference: from HeroStalk's right Step: settles (root 0.5 studs forward, Quad Out, 0.6667 s), bends with weight, the right fist closes on the top of the food in front of the right foot (Grab 1.2667; food centre (1.01, -2.09, -2.71) in root space, weld (0,-(0.15+r),0) under the RightHand), rises slowly and lifts it out to the right at shoulder height (Lift 2.0333), a confident hold (Hold 2.2333); 2.5 s, holds the last pose
clips._intent: the reveal: the silhouette picks the thrown food up before it is revealed (owner's review 4)

roblox_owned.walk_run_jump: default R15 Animate ids read from a playtest character
roblox_owned._emotes_note: ANIMATION ids inside Roblox's free emotes (Salute, Applaud, Tilt, Hello, Shrug, Stadium, Point2), checked with AnimationClipProvider. Never the catalog emote ids (3360689775 ...): those fail with 'AnimationClip loaded is not valid'.

note: roblox-animation. Match a reference by ANGLE and fraction-of-reach, not distance. Search how the pose is really done before authoring and judge the contact sheet against _intent. Clips must be uploaded by the place owner to play in a live server.
